The four tables list every atom of one conventional cubic cell of four crystals (files named by crystal). Use the kinematic structure factor with atomic numbers as angle-independent weights and first-order Bragg diffraction; the relevant peak is the lowest-angle reflection with non-zero intensity. Weights: copper: Cu = 29; Ni O: Ni = 28, O = 8; Nb3 Sn: Nb = 41, Sn = 50; Buckminsterfullerene: C = 6. For X-rays of wavelength 2.28970 Å, you must choose the crystal whose lowest-angle reflection with non-zero intensity lies closest to 2θ = 66.70° (for example, to calibrate a detector at that angle). Which crystal should you choose?

A. copper (COD5000216-cell.txt)
B. Ni O (COD4320505-cell.txt)
